sources.note: Charter of the Village of Enosburg Falls, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 219 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 4 provides a Board of five Trustees on staggered 3-year terms.

Village of Enosburg Falls Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025 (villageofenosburgfalls.org): the List of Principal Officials names Eli Gabuzda (Chair, term printed 2026), Heather Moore (Vice Chair, 2026), Leonard Charron (2027), Jason Longway (2027, appointed), and David Gervais (2028).

Village of Enosburg Falls Board of Trustees DRAFT minutes, September 22, 2026 (villageofenosburgfalls.org): Gabuzda chairs the September 22, 2026 trustees' meeting and Charron, Gervais, and Longway sit; Moore is absent from the roll. Gabuzda's seat stood at the March 10, 2026 election and he holds it; Moore's seat also stood in March 2026, its outcome is published nowhere, and she does not sit in September 2026, so her seat is left unfilled.
Charter of the Village of Enosburg Falls, 24 Appendix V.S.A. ch. 219 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 3(a) provides that the annual meeting elects a Moderator for one year.

Village of Enosburg Falls Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025 (villageofenosburgfalls.org): the List of Principal Officials names Patrick Hayes as Moderator to 2026; the March 10, 2026 election outcome is published nowhere, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.
